instruction: Create adjustment layers with layer masks for color correction in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: GIMP does not support adjustment layers as a native feature. While GIMP has layer masks, it lacks dedicated adjustment layers (like Curves, Levels, Hue/Saturation as separate layer types) that allow non-destructive color correction. All color adjustments in GIMP are destructive unless manually duplicated to preserve originals.
